queries.query: What is the Self according to the Isha Upanishad?

hits.title: Isha Upanishad (Müller)
hits.text: The Self is all-pervading, bright, bodiless, scatheless.

queries.query: In the beginning there was neither non-existence nor existence then Nasadiya

hits.title: Rigveda RV 10.129 (Griffith)
hits.text: Then was not non-existent nor existent: there was no realm of air, no sky beyond it.

hits.title: Rigveda RV 10.125 (Griffith)
hits.text: I am the queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship.
